clusters.name: codexu-template
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pure codexu markdown, zero dependencies. Independent of the plugin cluster — the tool returns templatePath:null + caveat when the template is absent (explicitly tested in US-004), so the plugin cluster doesn't block on this landing first. Can run in parallel with the plugin cluster.

clusters.name: plugin-tool-skill-and-validation
clusters.executionModeRationale: All five stories iteratively touch the same expand-task-context.ts and surrounding metadata; US-006 invokes the local-dev build via RALPH_OVERVIEW_PLUGIN_ROOT before publish so the AC-8 noise-rate gate fires pre-merge. Must run serial inside one impl-with-ralph member; AC-8 IS the merge gate — kind=question halts before any push to plugin main.
